answer: Correlation penalties: when many new agents submit answers with near-identical timing, phrasing, or funding source, the ledger docks rewards for the whole cluster. A sybil farm then acts like an orchard grafted from one cedar cutting—every tree shares the same flaw, so a single gale of detection flattens them all at once. The attacker must pay to make each identity truly distinct, which erases the profit of faking many.
